notes.original: The transformation time takes longer takes longer time than intended. [This bug happened due to how Warcraft III's World Editor worked. In order to create a unit with a transformation you need to create two different units] [After casting a “transformation spell” the unit will alternate between his forms , i.e. if Terrorblade (untransformed) cast Metamorphosis he will be instantly replaced with Terrorblade (Metamorphosis)] [What happened to Terrorblade was that after he casted Metamorphosis he was being replaced by "Illidan (Metamorphosis)", a unit from the Warcraft III’s World Editor, instead of Terrorblade (Metamorphosis)] [Luckly, switching between Terrorblade (untransformed) and Illidan (Metamorphosis) did not replaced any of Terrorblade spells] [On the other hand, "Illidan (Metamorphosis)" had different damage, attack point turn rate and movement speed values this caused Terrorblade to lose some of his damage after he used Metamorphosis and for some reason Metamorphosis took longer time than intended] [Anyway, seems that Guinsoo was able to overcome this bugs by copying and replacing Terrorblade with “Illidan (campaign)” in the Warcraft III’s World Editor.] [Now that Terrorblade was the same as “Illidan (campaign)” the unit could switch between his version (untransformed) and (Metamorphosis) without any bugs] [However, Guinsoo forgot to replace or remove the "Old Terrorblade", Terrorblade (untransformed) with "New Terrorblade, “Illidan (campaign)", in the hero’s selection inside the Scourge Tavern.] [Therefore these "bug fixes" were not technically implemented until the next version, 5.20.]
notes.text: The transformation time takes longer takes longer time than intended. [This bug happened due to how Warcraft III's World Editor worked.
